scope: Final manual Previous/Next behavior after the first implementation was found to prioritize a collection neighbor over the actual previously watched video.
boundary: Browser cases exercise the real React App and PlayerPage using trusted Playwright keyboard/pointer input.
API responses and media decoding are controlled fixtures. All non-development-server HTTP and WebSocket requests are intercepted.
This file documents local checks only; it does not claim television playback, real stream decoding or actual network quality.
Known previous and forward session entries take priority over multipart, collection and episode neighbors. Native order applies when that direction has no recorded session neighbor.
Explicit playlists retain authority over their ordering, boundaries and invalid indices.
Manual switching starts at zero. Session history is bounded to 50 items and resets on a new entry or player exit.
Account data, network addresses, video identifiers and titles are omitted.

notes: navigation-local.json preserves the earlier implementation evidence. Its native-first multipart expectation was superseded after television testing exposed the collection-entry gap.
The collection reproduction failed before the final helper change and passed afterward. Its stable source hashes are retained for both runs.
All 20 final browser cases ran together against unchanged production source hashes; the separate 27-case pure suite also passed on the same final navigation helper.

Final browser coverage includes outside-collection entry, nonadjacent same-collection history, forward history overriding a conflicting native next item, multipart return chains, explicit playlist boundaries, paging failures, duplicate-request locks, exit/re-entry isolation, same-key stale callbacks and end-of-stream races.
